profile_text.body:
Physical Intelligence is a company focused on bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. Its team includes engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders who develop learning algorithms intended to produce a model capable of controlling any robot to perform any task.

The company's primary AI work centers on generalist robot policies. Its first such model, π0, combined large-scale multi-task and multi-robot data collection with a new network architecture, which the company describes as enabling the most capable and dexterous generalist robot policy to date. A subsequent model, π0.5, extends π0 with what the company calls open-world generalization, demonstrated through a mobile manipulator that can clean up an entirely new kitchen or bedroom without prior exposure to that environment. The site tracks π0 under the emerging and frontier AI category, noting its relevance to physical task learning, safety-critical applications, and emerging governance standards.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data for Physical Intelligence.
